prompt: What laptop accessories are actually worth buying?
answer:
There are a wide variety of laptop accessories to choose from that can help you optimize your productivity and enhance your computing experience. Here are some of the most important ones.

First is a laptop bag. This is essential if you will be traveling with your laptop frequently. There are many options to choose from, but a good rule of thumb is that the bag should be able to fit your laptop with some extra room for accessories. It should also have padded compartments and be easy to carry around. A personal favorite is the case logic sl500. 

Second is a mouse. Laptops do not have a mouse built-in, and buying an external mouse can greatly improve your computing experience. There are generally two types of mice, optical and trackball. An optical mouse is the more traditional type, and requires movement to operate. A trackball mouse operates the same way as an optical mouse, but does not move around as you use it. 

Third is a keyboard. Laptop keyboards are generally compact and small, which can make typing difficult for some people. There are many external keyboards to choose from, with the biggest distinction being wired vs bluetooth. Both can work well, it's just a matter of preference. 

Fourth is a screen. If you do a lot of work on your computer, having a second screen can greatly improve your productivity. It can be used to keep commonly used applications open, such as a notes application, reference documents, code or your email. There are many options for external screens, but it's important to consider the following:
- Size. How big do you want your screen to be?
- Resolution. Many screens today are 4k resolution, which means the image will be very crisp and clear. This can be important for applications that require a lot of detail, such as video editing or photo editing.
- HDMI or USB-C input. This will determine how the screen is attached to your laptop. HDMI is the more traditional option and is used by most screens,
